nodes.title: Scaffold the HTTP server with a health check
nodes.description: A main package that listens on $ADDR (default :8080) and answers GET /healthz with 200 ok.

nodes.title: Add an in-memory store for to-do items
nodes.description: A Store with Add, Get, List, SetDone and Delete, safe for concurrent use.

nodes.title: Implement the /todos CRUD handlers
nodes.description: GET/POST /todos and GET/PATCH/DELETE /todos/{id}, JSON in and out, 400 and 404 as JSON errors.

nodes.title: Cover the handlers with tests
nodes.description: httptest-based tests for create, list, complete, the empty-title 400 and unknown-id 404; attach the coverage report.

nodes.title: Document the API in the README
nodes.description: A table of every endpoint, how to run the service and what an error looks like.

nodes.title: Review the API before the first release
nodes.description: A second person reads the handlers and the tests before the README is written.
